{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust downward for persistent overestimation in early forecast periods (e.g., first 5-7 days of 30d forecast).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias correction when true outcome deviates >10% from recent 5-day average, especially if sentiment is neutral.",
    "Lower forecast if sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or below) for 3+ consecutive days.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is positive (e.g., +0.50 or above) to avoid underestimating rebound potential.",
    "Cap forecast at 10% above recent 7-day high if sentiment is neutral or positive to prevent overcorrection.",
    "Adjust downward for forecasts that consistently overpredict early days of 30d horizon (e.g., days 1-3) when historical data shows downward drift."
  ]
}
